shortDescription: Australian unemployment climbed further in August even as the economy added more jobs than anticipated, according to Bloomberg.The data came just days before the Reserve Bank meets to consider resuming interest-rate increases.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Australian Unemployment Rises in August Despite Stronger-Than-Expected Job Gains
